idea.name: Phone Restore phone repair shop

claims.claim: The business opened while the family had a six-month-old baby, and Jesse did shifts there.
claims.quote: And well, just going into the first business too with a six-month old baby, opening a phone repair shop and me doing shifts there with a baby behind the wall.

claims.claim: The store was described as 2,000 feet.
claims.quote: For those watching or listening, we had this 2,000 foot store and we just put a a drywall wall that just split up the front from the back.

claims.claim: The location took months to gain traction.

claims.claim: They still received inquiries about the business 15 years later.

ideas.delivery: The owners repaired phones and iPads and served customers at the shop.
